rules.description: Child or young person must be aged 0-25
rules.reason_if_failed: EHC plans are only available for children and young people aged 0 to 25

rules.description: Child or young person must not be over 25
rules.reason_if_failed: EHC plans are only available for children and young people up to age 25

rules.description: Child must be resident in the local authority area
rules.reason_if_failed: You must apply to the local authority where the child lives

rules.description: Child must have complex SEND needs that cannot be met through standard SEN support
rules.reason_if_failed: Standard SEN support should be tried first. Contact your school's SENCO to arrange SEN support.
You must provide reports from school/nursery, medical assessments, and a letter describing your child's needs

explanation_template: EHC plan assessment eligibility: {outcome}. The local authority will decide within 16 weeks whether to proceed with the assessment.

edge_cases.action: Follow Early Years Foundation Stage framework. May still qualify for EHC plan if needs are complex. Ensure health visitor check and 2-year progress check are referenced.
Young person can request assessment themselves. Parental consent not required but parental input is valuable.

edge_cases.description: Child has a statement of SEN from before September 2014
edge_cases.action: Existing statement will convert to EHC plan at next planned review or school transition. Continue with conversion process.
Immediately handoff to local authority safeguarding team. EHC assessment continues in parallel with safeguarding investigation.

edge_cases.description: Parent/young person disagrees with local authority decision
edge_cases.action: Route to mediation and potentially SEND Tribunal. Handoff to Independent Parental Special Education Advice (IPSEA) for support.

edge_cases.description: Personal budget requested for implementing the plan
edge_cases.action: Separate personal budget assessment process. Can use direct payments, notional arrangements, or third-party arrangements.
